sb_prompt: FIND OUT WHAT BOOKS THE OTHER CALLER READS FOR ENJOYMENT OR SELF-IMPROVEMENT.         DO YOU HAVE SIMILAR OR DIFFERENT INTERESTS IN BOOKS?
raw_output:
ParticipantA: Hi, I'm looking for someone to talk to about books and literature. Do you have any interest in that kind of thing?

ParticipantB: Uh, yeah, I guess. I mean, I've read some books, but I don't know if I could call myself a big reader.

ParticipantA: Oh, that's okay. I love reading, and I'm always looking for new recommendations. Do you have any favorites?

ParticipantB: Well, I really liked "The Catcher in the Rye" in high school. I don't read as much anymore, but I've been trying to make time for it again.

ParticipantA: I read "The Catcher in the Rye" in college and really enjoyed it too. Have you read any other books that you would recommend?

ParticipantB: Not recently, to be honest. I read a lot of non-fiction for work, but for fun, I usually stick to mystery novels or something light.

ParticipantA: Oh, I love mystery novels. Have you read any good ones lately?

ParticipantB: Yeah, I just finished "Gone Girl" by Gillian Flynn. It was really good, and I'm not usually a fan of thrillers.

ParticipantA: I've been meaning to read that one! I've heard it's a real page-turner. What did you think of the ending?

ParticipantB: Well, I won't spoil it for you, but I thought it was really well done. It's definitely not what you expect.

ParticipantA: Oh, I'll have to check it out then. I'm always looking for books that surprise me. Do you have any other recommendations?

ParticipantB: Not really, like I said, I don't read as much as I used to. But I do have a friend who's really into literature, so maybe I can ask her for some suggestions.

ParticipantA: That's a good idea. I love getting book recommendations from friends too. Well, thanks for chatting with me about books. It was nice talking to you.

ParticipantB: Yeah, you too. Have fun reading!
